releaseNotes:
Synced with upstream v0.1.81 + fork customizations.

Upstream changes:
- fix(usage): respect server TZ for today filter and daily aggregation
- fix(usage): drain queued records in batches
- fix(proxy/status): probe management API for liveness instead of docker ps name match
- fix(perplexity-sidecar): port to perplexity-webui-scraper 1.0.x API
- fix(install): make systemd compose command cwd-portable
- chore: migrate from CLIProxyAPIPlus to CLIProxyAPI
- feat(custom-providers): allow admins to share custom providers globally
